question: Generally, which language is used to construct World Wide Web pages?
solution:
The correct answer is __HTML.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Hypertext Markup Language (HTML) is used to create documents for use on the world wide web.
 
• Tim Berners-Lee specified HTML in 1990 and he wrote the browser and server software.
 
• The latest version of HTML is HTML 5.2 released in the year 2017, by WHATWG.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The World Wide Web or WWW is a collection of web pages found in the network of computers.
 
• Internet is an example of the world wide web.
 
• The World Wide Web was developed by Tim Berners-Lee in 1989. Tim wrote the first web browser in 1990 near Geneva, Switzerland where he was employed in CERN.
 
• The resources of the web could be accessed by the Web browser and resources are transferred via the Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP).
